name: ShopDeck
shortDescription: E-commerce operations admin: order/inventory state machines, pricing audit, data-quality-flagged reports.
features: Order state machine (placed→paid→packed→shipped→delivered / cancelled / refunded) with illegal-transition rejections (409)
Inventory state machine incl. discontinued terminal state
Discount rules with guardrails (0–80% off, min-subtotal) and per-order pricing audit JSON
Sales report with data-quality flags (orders with no lines) and scope note
knownLimitations: Demo catalog simulated; no payment provider integration (by design)
